conditions: reference_building_id must be one of the three Hazard reference profiles r1 buildings
mesh_diameter_mm is Hazard's MESH75 hail diameter (mm) as delivered, read as the largest hailstone at the building
records are valid from 0 to 203.2 mm; above 203.2 withholds; a negative diameter is rejected

each failure unit's damage ratio is a fraction of that unit's own replacement value; the unit's share of structure replacement cost new is in the value crosswalk and failure_units[].share_of_structure_rcn
the walls-and-windows unit is Tier-4 screening and answers only with screening_assumption_set_id = HRE_T4_WALLS_WINDOWS_SCREENING_2026_10_18
exposed equipment and contents are withheld, never zero
scenario dollars stay withheld until the consumer qualifies the building value
owner acceptance of the scope and selections is required before any canonical use
DR multiplies the selected failure unit own replacement value, never the whole-building budget
No renormalization of uncovered building value and no default equipment response

prerequisites: Exact source and per-profile own-unit value pins
Current curated MESH 1.3 severe-event parent with MESH75 bridge applied exactly once; no raw-June NRI multiplier
Explicit source-native 625 equally weighted point placements; one fixed native point throughout each simulated year, not observed property stock or DEM siting
Shared event/intensity draws for roof and walls/windows, separate annual component caps then building contribution sum
Original zero and unavailable source/event mass retained; positive frequency without magnitude remains a non-answer contribution
Annual sampling convergence, MC error, value/cap/mass/tail checks and national readback before annual delivery

checks_required: record routing by failure_unit_id and reference_building_id
unit DR multiplied by the same unit's share of structure value, never by the whole value
walls-and-windows unit used only with the screening acknowledgement
all perils on one building in one event together at most 100% of structure value
cap_binding.action_if_fail: withhold the affected DR or downstream metric; do not substitute another record or clamp

required_before_canonical_use: Unchanged material/source response admission; Hazard annual use requires all conditional consumer prerequisites
